finalProse.chartStory: BEN rolled over from recent highs and the latest red pressure pushed into and through the 20-day average. That leaves sellers in control for now.
finalProse.whyItMatters: This is different from a healthy reset because the recent candles are showing damage first, not a calm move into support.
finalProse.setupLocation: Price is no longer just touching the 20-day average cleanly. The support area has been damaged and the chart needs repair before it can look healthier again.
finalProse.learningPoint: A support touch is not enough on its own. If sellers drive through that area, traders treat the pullback as damaged instead of assuming buyers will save it.
finalProse.whatNext: Watch for the selling to settle and for buyers to rebuild the area before trusting BEN as a pullback setup again.
